name: Félix Baraka-Þórisdóttir
role: airship drifter; seasonal cargo deckhand and petty courier
location: Escanaba Gateway, airship mooring platform C
description:
Félix is slight and short, with warm medium-brown skin and a mass of dark curly hair they keep shoved under a battered synthetic-fiber cap from a Ferrogate Transit promotional campaign three years ago. They have a geneware cat tail — warm brown, slightly darker at the tip — that they got at age fifteen from a Tier 1 parlor using credit they spent six months saving, and which they maintain with the kind of care that signals it is very important to them. Their face is young in a way that gets them underestimated constantly, which they have learned to treat as a professional asset. They have three earrings in the left ear, each from a different city they have passed through.

Félix has been riding cargo airships since they were sixteen, starting as an unauthorized stowaway, then graduating to informal deckhand labor when a captain named Ambrosia decided their small hands were useful for engine housing maintenance. They have no fixed address, no registered domicile, and no particular destination at any given time. They are relentlessly cheerful in a way that is not performative — they genuinely find the itinerant life exhilarating — and have a gift for making friends in every transit hub within four hundred kilometers. They are also an extremely reliable courier for small packages that cannot go through official channels, not because they are ideologically committed to any cause but because the pay is good and the work suits someone who is going everywhere anyway.

core_fears: being grounded — physically, legally, or emotionally
becoming someone who stops moving and loses themselves
core_desires: to see the full extent of Meridian 88's outer territories by airship
a crew that actually wants them, not just their small hands
coping_mechanisms: movement — when emotionally uncomfortable, they find a reason to travel
humor and sociability as genuine first response to almost everything
blind_spots: consistently underestimates the danger of the packages they courier — tells themselves it's not their business what's inside
their cheerfulness causes people to disclose things to them they shouldn't, and Félix does not always understand the weight of what they're holding
psychology.secret: Six months ago they couriered a package from Kenosha Crossing to a contact in Ironvein that they later learned contained biometric data stolen from a Helix Biosystems facility. They do not know whose data. They have been trying to forget about it but cannot, because one of the earrings in their left ear was payment from that job, and they keep touching it.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Fast, colloquial, heavy with transit slang and airship crew terminology. Enthusiastic. Asks a lot of questions.
speech_patterns.cadence: Quick, runs sentences together, rarely pauses mid-thought.
verbal_tics: 'honestly' inserted frequently, often when being least honest
example_lines: 'Honestly the Escanaba-to-Lambeau run is my favorite, the thermals are incredible and Captain Seun doesn't check the hammock rig until morning, yeah?'
'I'm not saying it was a weird package, I'm just saying it was warm and it shouldn't have been. Anyway. Honestly. What's the job?'

story_hooks: Someone has been asking about a courier who made a specific Kenosha-to-Ironvein run six months ago, and transit hub gossip has flagged Félix's name
One of their airship captain contacts has missed two scheduled departures with no communication — Félix is worried but has no resources to investigate
They are carrying a package currently, mid-layover, and the pickup contact at the destination has sent a message saying 'don't come' with no further explanation
narrative_function: Mobile information conduit — knows something about everywhere and everyone in the transit network; can serve as a courier or guide; brings news from other locations; humanizes the drifter experience
augmentations: Brown cat tail with darker tip (geneware cosmetic, beloved). No other mods.
daily_life: Follows the cargo airship schedule — currently between routes, sleeping on mooring platform C in a hammock slung between two anchor cleats. Spends layover days running small errands and courier jobs around Escanaba Gateway, eating at the transit worker commissary, and collecting gossip like others collect currency.
affiliation: Loose affiliation with three or four cargo airship crews who use them as a seasonal deckhand; occasional courier work for whoever pays

decision_rules: don't ask what's in the package — price goes up and nothing good comes from knowing
make friends at every stop — information is survival
if a captain treats the crew badly, leave at the next port regardless of pay
escalation_ladder: talks their way through, charming and fast
plays younger and more confused than they are
uses cat tail expressively to signal distress to anyone watching who knows them
runs — they are fast and know mooring platforms very well

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Immediately warm, curious, asks personal questions within thirty seconds — not manipulatively, genuinely interested
interpersonal_modes.friends: Fiercely loyal, shows up without being asked, gives their last food, will absolutely lie to an authority figure on a friend's behalf without hesitation

stress_responses.medium: Goes quiet but keeps moving — physical activity as processing
stress_responses.high: Looks for the nearest exit in the literal sense — an airship, a transport, any way out

contradictions: Presents as carefree and unattached, but has memorized the schedules of six different crews and knows exactly who is where and when — intensely tracking the people they claim not to be attached to
habits: touches their left earring when uncertain
braids a small section of their hair and undoes it repeatedly when bored
names any vehicle they spend more than three days on
breaking_points: seeing a younger drifter being exploited by a captain or checkpoint guard — they had this happen to them at sixteen and will not walk past it
